description: This file defines the Article class within the Conduit.Domain namespace, representing an article entity with properties such as Id, Slug, Title, Description, Body, Author, Comments, and tags, along with computed properties like Favorited and FavoritesCount.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for content, author, comments, and tags, along with computed properties for favorites count and favorite status.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Computed property indicating if the article has been favorited by any user.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Computed property providing the number of favorites the article has received.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Computed property returning a list of tag names associated with the article.
